# Muhammad Usama Saleem

> Applied Scientist II at Amazon working on multimodal foundation models for 3D human
> perception and synthesis. Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of North
> Carolina at Charlotte (2026), advised by Prof. Pu Wang in the GENIUS Lab.
> Previously a Research Scientist Intern on Google's Extended Reality (AR/VR) team.

Research focus: multimodal foundation models that unify real-time perception with
high-fidelity synthesis — 3D human pose estimation and mesh reconstruction via
generative masked modeling, controllable 3D human motion and co-speech gesture
generation, and interactive digital humans for immersive XR environments.
Holds U.S. Patent US20260065565A1 on 3D human pose and movement estimation from
monocular images.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://m-usamasaleem.github.io/): bio, experience timeline, news, selected research, publications
- [Publications](https://m-usamasaleem.github.io/publication/): full publication list with PDFs and code

## Selected research

- LiveGesture — streamable co-speech gesture generation (CVPR 2026)
- Walk Before You Dance — editable dance synthesis via generative masked motion prior (AAAI 2026)
- MaskHand — generative masked modeling for robust hand mesh reconstruction (ICCV 2025)
- MaskControl — spatio-temporal control for masked motion synthesis (ICCV 2025, Oral, Best Paper Award Nominee)
- GenHMR — generative human mesh recovery (AAAI 2025)
- BioPose — biomechanically-accurate 3D pose estimation from monocular videos (WACV 2025)
